opening.argument: The segment reports on Wells Fargo board members stepping down after a damaging report, then criticizes their alleged failure to address complaints about consumer abuse. It attributes its account to a House Financial Services Committee report and describes fines tied to unnecessary financial products and insurance charges. The separate Patreon request supports the media publisher; it is not presented as connected to Wells Fargo, a promised return, a credential request, or a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: Wells Fargo Board Members Step Down Following Damaging Report
after reports showed that these board members had ignored complaints that the bank was abusing consumers for decades
The report issued by the house financial services committee specifically called out the two board members
the bank has paid billions of dollars in fines for things like selling unnecessary financial products to customers, charging customers for insurance that they absolutely did not need
